Have governments taken fiscal spending too far? How much room do they have left to tackle another crisis? What did Nehru's economic model get right and where did it go wrong? How should you read India's inflation numbers? And why are the rupee and stock markets under pressure despite relative geopolitical calm? In this episode of , ThePrint Consulting Editor (Economics) Dr Bidisha Bhattacharya answers these questions, with Manya Gupta.
